title: Q15
description:
Read: Psa 110:1-4

David calls this one Lord. The same speech seats him until the enemies are the footstool, and swears he is priest forever.

a) What does David's "my Lord" give this sitting that no text about angels can give?

b) The priestly oath is in the same speech as the sitting. What is already being held, before the priesthood is argued?
